description: Tevimbra in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-containing chemotherapy is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with non-squamous NSCLC whose tumors have PD-L1 expression on >= 50% of tumor cells with no EGFR or ALK positive mutations and who have (i) locally advanced NSCLC and are not candidates for surgical resection or platinum-based chemoradiation, or (ii) metastatic NSCLC.
